acceptance: every acceptance row is verified against exact main before it is recorded
ACCEPTED is unrepresentable without at least one evidence reference
BLOCKED and REGRESSED are unrepresentable without a stated blocking reason
final_status is derived from the backlog and can never be supplied by a caller
PASS requires every mandatory item accepted and no regression anywhere
reported percentages ship with the counts and the formula that produced them
the committed gap report and manifest are re-derivable from the committed backlog with zero drift
forbidden_capabilities: model bundle, benchmark, admission authority, runtime-host or quality-scoring changes
Gateway, UI, routing, feature-flag or production deployment changes
any production readiness or operational attestation claim
